column1: # Override families: a prefix of the raw string, and the tournament biome it means.
# Compiled into Lms.Core (KnownBiomes); a test asserts this file and the code agree, and that
# every string in biome-overrides.tsv resolves through one of these rules or the biome table.
# Matched case-insensitively, longest prefix first, and BEFORE table-name prefixes -- otherwise
# BloodKelp_Trench would collapse into bloodKelp, which is the mistake this whole mechanism exists
# Reached through an atmosphere prefab rather than the world data. As a
# prefix it also covers FloatingIslandBelow and the cave teleporter, neither of which any batch
# points at today -- but a place you can stand on should not depend on that staying true.
